quarterly_data.signal: MARA Q2 2026 shareholder letter (8-K Exhibit 99.1): MARA sold 2,213 BTC at an average price of $73,078 in Q2 2026 and purchased no BTC; it expects to continue to monetize bitcoin opportunistically as 2026 progresses, including to provide liquidity or to fund capital projects, subject to market conditions. Versus Q1 2026, blocks won rose to 700 from 653, BTC produced to 2,422 from 2,247 and average BTC produced per day to 26.6 from 25.0, while energized hashrate was 70.3 EH/s versus 72.2 EH/s (down 3%); MARA's share of available miner rewards was 5.9% versus 5.5%. Purchased energy cost per bitcoin at its owned and operated sites was $38,690, up from $33,735 in Q2 2025, primarily driven by higher power costs and global network difficulty outpacing its hashrate growth; power costs rose versus the prior quarter due to adverse weather events. The letter describes MARA's mining platform as 19 data centers across four continents.
